title: ieee80211: Add DSB decryption key support for 802.11
description:
This MR adds support for embedding 802.11 decryption keys within a `.pcapng` file by adding a Decryption Secrets Block for such keys, teaching wireshark to pull them out, and adding support for `editcap` to put them in.  This is useful to be able to easily share `.pcapng` files that self-decrypt, once the keys have been added to them.

This MR was AI-assisted.  I have reviewed the contents and ensured that reasonable design decisions were made, however I may be lacking some greater project context, and welcome all review comments.

notes.body:
added 9 commits
  • 7d009710...15991340 - 6 commits from branch wireshark:master
  • ea77bea6 - ieee80211: Add DSB decryption key support for 802.11
  • 36829958 - editcap: Add --inject-secrets wifi for 802.11 key injection
  • b4a23ee2 - test: Add tests for 802.11 DSB key injection and decryption
[Compare with previous version](/wireshark/wireshark/-/merge_requests/24087/diffs?diff_id=1725892396&start_sha=7d0097104ad4af463625c47f197ab4c38f1ad820)

I personally have tested this with `tk` keys garnered from a `hostapd` with two clients connected.  I haven't tested any other key types, considering getting one type working proves the plumbing is correct.

You first need to file a pull request for the pcapng specification on [the GitHub repository for pcap/pcapng specs](https://github.com/IETF-OPSAWG-WG/draft-ietf-opsawg-pcap?tab=readme-ov-file) to add the new DSB secret type.
That PR has been open for a few months with no activity; is there some way that I should attract attention from a maintainer, or is simply opening the PR enough to make forward progress here?
Making forward progress *here* is not going to happen until the PR for the pcapng specification is accepted. Getting forward progress on the latter is a different, and important question.
Do you have any guidance for the latter?

@@ -322,6 +322,39 @@ class TestDecrypt80211:
         assert count_output(stdout, 'EAPOL') == 2

+class TestDecrypt80211Dsb:
+    def test_80211_wep_dsb(self, cmd_tshark, cmd_editcap, dirs, capture_file, result_file, base_env):
+        '''IEEE 802.11 WEP decryption from pcapng DSB'''
+        key_file = os.path.join(dirs.key_dir, 'wifi-wep.keys')
+        outfile = result_file('wep-dsb.pcapng')
+        subprocess.run((cmd_editcap,
+            '--inject-secrets', 'wifi,%s' % key_file,
+            capture_file('wep.pcapng.gz'), outfile
+        ), check=True, env=base_env)
+        stdout = subprocess.check_output((cmd_tshark,
+                '-o', 'wlan.enable_decryption: TRUE',
+                '-r', outfile,
+                ), encoding='utf-8', env=base_env)
+        assert grep_output(stdout, 'Who has 192.168.5.1')
+        assert grep_output(stdout, r'Echo \(ping\) request')
+
+    def test_80211_wpa_pwd_dsb(self, cmd_tshark, cmd_editcap, dirs, capture_file, result_file, base_env):
+        '''IEEE 802.11 WPA-PWD decryption from pcapng DSB'''
+        key_file = os.path.join(dirs.key_dir, 'wifi-wpa-pwd.keys')
+        outfile = result_file('wpa-induction-dsb.pcapng')
+        subprocess.run((cmd_editcap,
+            '--inject-secrets', 'wifi,%s' % key_file,
+            capture_file('wpa-Induction.pcap.gz'), outfile
+        ), check=True, env=base_env)
+        stdout = subprocess.check_output((cmd_tshark,
+                '-o', 'wlan.enable_decryption: TRUE',
+                '-Tfields',
+                '-e', 'http.request.uri',
+                '-r', outfile,
+                '-Y', 'http',
+            ), encoding='utf-8', env=base_env)
+        assert grep_output(stdout, 'favicon.ico')
+
